+-- export class CodeEntity implements SelectableText

|   |   +-- rangeIndex = stable sourceRangeId lookup, else sourceRangeIndex ?? 0

|   \-- prompt_str(): string
|       +-- ranges = sourceRanges.map(render range).join(newline)
|       |   +-- symbol = optional parenthesized symbol
|       |   +-- sections = optional compactedSource sections joined by newline
|       |   |   +-- source section -> retain lines startLine-endLine
|       |   |   +-- collapsed-comment -> collapse lines as call graph; normalize newlines and indent
|       |   |   \-- nonempty nodes -> append graph-line to source-line mappings
|       |   +-- compaction = optional level + rendered sections
|       |   \-- return path:startLine-endLine + symbol + compaction
|       \-- return entity handle, label, category, summary and rendered source ranges
+-- function promptAliasHash(value: string): string
|   +-- hash = 0x811c9dc5
|   +-- for each UTF-16 code unit: XOR into hash; Math.imul(hash, 0x01000193)
|   \-- return unsigned 32-bit hash as zero-padded 8-digit hex
+-- export function qualifiedCodeEntityPromptAlias(entity: CodeEntityRecord): string

+-- export function createCodeEntityPromptAliases( entities: readonly CodeEntityRecord[] ): CodeEntityPromptAlias[]

|   +-- handleCounts = case-insensitive handle frequency map

|       +-- unique handle -> entity-<handle>
|       \-- colliding handle -> qualifiedCodeEntityPromptAlias(entity)
+-- export function resolveCodeEntityPromptAliases( aliases: readonly string[], allowed: readonly CodeEntityPromptAlias[] ): string[]
|   +-- idsByAlias = Map populated from allowed entries
